The fetched logo.svg (sha256 8f28cd53cdfde6d31f3edfea178de3db5eb4a81732a4516962fa6a9936fba4c4) is an original single-path vector, fill-rule evenodd, fill #FCB000, viewBox 0 0 23 17: the rounded VB tile with the V as a knocked-out counter. Its render visually matches the current icon's design; only the fill differs.
